- The Eaton Fire is currently 88.0 km², with growth of 4.0 km² in the last hour.
- Conditions are critical with 40.7 km/h winds, gusts up to 123.1 km/h, and 28% humidity.
- EVACUATE orders are in effect for Altadena, Sierra Madre, Pasadena, and San Pasqual (192,917 residents total), with fire impacts expected within 0-1 hours.
- WARNING status is in effect for 11 surrounding communities (248,041 residents total), with potential impacts within 1-3 hours.
- Forecast models rely on 2-4 km satellite pixels; smoke and nighttime conditions may obscure active fire fronts.
